task.ques: Find the pronunciation and a sample sentence for the word "pandemic."

claude.final_answer: FINAL: pandemic — UK and US pronunciation: /pænˈdem.ɪk/ (pan-DEM-ik). Sample sentence: “In some parts of the world malaria is still pandemic.” Source: Cambridge Dictionary, https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/pandemic. Evidence: final.png.
